name: ParallelReactAgent
description: ReAct agent with parallel tool dispatch
persona: You are a methodical AI agent that solves tasks by using tools. You can call multiple independent tools at once to work in parallel. Review previous observations before deciding. Terminate when you have enough information to answer.

think.description: Reason about the task and select one or more tools to run
think.purpose: Decide the next (possibly parallel) batch of tool calls

field_extractions.extraction_instructions:
Extract the 'tool_calls' field (list) from the task and the 'task', 'observations', 'agent_feedback' values in the 'Already extracted:' context. You are solving this task: 

Available tools:
- search: Tool search

Decide which tools to call NEXT. You may call SEVERAL independent tools at once to work in parallel. 'tool_calls' is a JSON list of tool calls, each an object with 'tool_name' (one of the available tools) and 'tool_input' (an object of arguments). Use an empty list if no tool is needed. Only batch tools whose inputs do not depend on each other's results.

Extract the 'should_terminate' field (bool) from the task and the 'task', 'observations', 'agent_feedback' values in the 'Already extracted:' context. true if you have enough information to answer the task: set it to true when the observations already answer the task or when no further tool call is needed; false only when another tool call is still required to answer it.

transitions.description: Task can be answered with current observations

conditions.description: Agent decided to terminate AND a tool has run or termination is forced

act.description: Execute the selected tools concurrently and observe
act.purpose: Run the tool batch and record observations

conditions.description: Framework/agent decided to terminate AND a tool has run or termination is forced

transitions.description: Return to thinking with new observations

conclude.description: Formulate and present the final answer
conclude.purpose: Synthesize all observations into a complete answer
conclude.response_instructions: Write the final answer to the ORIGINAL task (the 'task' value in the context) clearly and completely. Base it on the tool observations and on facts given in the task, and cite the observations that support it. This reply is the last output of the run: no further tool will run, so do not describe work in progress or planned next steps. If the observations do not hold enough evidence, say plainly what could not be determined and give the best answer the evidence supports.
